All three sub-tasks are done and committed in the worktree (`worktree/framework-home-grids`, 2 commits). The merge is blocked by one thing outside my control: the main repo is currently checked out on `michael/subcard-columns` (another active task's branch), and `merge.mjs` requires it to be on `michael/dev` before it will land anything — not something I should force by switching another agent's active checkout. Logged this on the task. I'll retry the merge once the main repo is back on `michael/dev`.

Summary of what's ready to land:
- **Voids filled, columns widened**: every section's card group now uses `.packed` instead of a plain equal-height grid — no more dead rectangles under short cards (Router, App, Sidebar...). Column floor raised 14em → 18em, so 3440 draws ~2 wide columns per section instead of 5 narrow ones.
- **Core/Styles gap**: measured directly (not eyeballed) — it was already even everywhere; no separate fix needed.
- **Explicit layout classes**: the converted containers now literally wear `.packed`.
- **Layout-labels dev toggle**: a new DevBar checkbox / `?layout=1` labels every grid/masonry/packed/sprawl container with its classes, computed layout, and nearest size container (the owner's mid-task addition) — found and fixed two real bugs along the way (an over-eager ancestor check that hid every section's label, and a hidden-element label pinned on top of the sidebar).
- **DevTools question answered**: it's a Chrome inspector display quirk from live-reload's in-place `<link>` href swap, not a bug — no safe code fix exists without risking the `@layer` ordering the current code deliberately protects.

All three sub-tasks (grid-fill, layout-labels, devtools-inline-css) are done, self-reviewed and committed in the worktree. The only remaining step is `Server/merge.mjs`, which is blocked because the main repo is currently checked out on `michael/subcard-columns` (another active task), not `michael/dev` — a hard requirement the merge tool checks regardless of flags. Not mine to force. Waiting for that branch to free up, then I'll retry the merge and close out with the after-screenshots already posted to the card.
